scope: AUDIT ONLY — no application or existing test edits; separate audit scripts/reports added
inventoryBasis: Source read and Playwright --list; fresh runtime supplied separately by root auditor

architecture.framework: React19.2.8 / TypeScript7.0.2 / Vite8.2.2 / React Router7.18.2 / Tailwind4.3.3
architecture.router: BrowserRouter + App Routes;1 pathless RequireSession Outlet group
architecture.state: Local React useState/useMemo/useEffect; assignment draft lifted into ClassroomDetailPage; session localStorage and useSyncExternalStore. No Redux/query-state dependency.
architecture.authentication: GIS popup -> POST /api/auth/session -> application bearer token; RequireSession GET /api/me before protected Outlet mounts
architecture.authorization: Backend capability matrix is security boundary; conditional frontend tools by classroom membership role.
architecture.api: apiFetch JSON normalizes ApiError and clears matching token401; separate CSV fetch helper; VITE_API_BASE_URL is build-time env.
architecture.forms: Classroom server validation; email regex/touched+server; assignment draftBlocker(name/deadline/students) and server numeric/weight rules; atomicCSV server validation; timezone calendar blocks past time.
architecture.errors: Banner/alert/status and busy flags; no React ErrorBoundary found; most data views loaded flag without explicit loading spinner.
architecture.unsupportedFlows: No password registration/reset, profile editing, room archive/delete mutation, notification, appeal, artifact upload or group-editor UI found; cannot label missing without current Figma/requirements mapping.
